source_proof.completion_write: Projection.run unload branch is the sole post-constructor completed write.
source_proof.single_assignment_scope: Restricted initial 3-tray/5-job population. load_waiting removes each waiting job by changing its jstatus to loading; no transition restores waiting. Initial loaded/blocker jobs are not waiting. complete_leg clears goal before scheduling unload and try_depart ignores no-goal trays.
source_proof.future_actions: return_decision/later_decision/route command do not modify a completed job or its recorded completion time.
source_proof.interpretation: A strict > witness refutes all-job protection in this pinned conditional model only; unexecuted suffix remains unknown.
source_proof.runtime_boundary: Reviewed repository functions and isolated builtin input, not a security boundary against arbitrary in-process monkeypatches.
